entries.title: Joshua 18:1
segments: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel gathered at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:2
segments: And there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes which had not yet received their inheritance.

entries.title: Joshua 18:3
segments: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will you fail to go in to possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers has given you?

entries.title: Joshua 18:4
segments: Give from among you three men for [each] tribe. And I will send them, and they shall rise and go through the land and map it according to the inheritance of them. And they shall come to me.

entries.title: Joshua 18:5
segments: And they shall divide it into seven parts. Judah shall stay within their border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stay within their borders on the north.

entries.title: Joshua 18:6
segments: And you shall map the land [into] seven parts and bring it here to me, so that I may cast lots here for you before the LORD our God.

entries.title: Joshua 18:7
segments: But the Levites have no part among you. For the priesthood of the LORD [is] their inheritance. And Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:8
segments: And the men arose and went away. And Joshua charged those who went to map the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and map it, and come again to me so that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

entries.title: Joshua 18:9
segments: And the men went and passed through the land, and mapped it by cities into seven parts in a book, and they came to Joshua, to the host at Shiloh.

entries.title: Joshua 18:10
segments: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. And Joshua divided the land to the sons of Israel there, according to their divisions.

entries.title: Joshua 18:11
segments: And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up by their families. And the border of their lot came forth between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

entries.title: Joshua 18:12
segments: And their border on the north side was from Jordan. And the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward. And their boundary was at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

entries.title: Joshua 18:13
segments: And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which [is] Bethel, southward. And the border went down to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the lower Beth-horon.

entries.title: Joshua 18:14
segments: And the border was drawn [from there], and went around the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that [is] in front of Beth-horon southward. And its boundary was at Kirjath-baal; it [is] Kirjath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah. This [was] the west quarter.

entries.title: Joshua 18:15
segments: And the south quarter [was] from the end of Kirjath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah;

entries.title: Joshua 18:16
segments: and the border went down to the end of the mountain that [is] before the valley of the sons of Hinnom, which [is] the Valley of the Giants northward, and went down the valley of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite on the south, and went down to En-rogel.

entries.title: Joshua 18:17
segments: And it was drawn from the north and went out to En-shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which [is] across from the ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

entries.title: Joshua 18:18
segments: and passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

entries.title: Joshua 18:19
segments: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward. And the boundary was at the north tongue of the Salt Sea, at the south end of Jordan. This [was] the south border.

entries.title: Joshua 18:20
segments: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This [was] the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, according to its borders all around, according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 18:21
segments: And the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

entries.title: Joshua 18:22
segments: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

entries.title: Joshua 18:23
segments: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:24
segments: and Chephar-haam-monai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 18:25
segments: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

entries.title: Joshua 18:26
segments: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:27
segments: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:28
segments: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which [is] Jerusalem; Gibeath, Kirjath; fourteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.
